product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic helps enterprises securely connect and orchestrate applications, data, APIs and AI agents across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as an enterprise operational layer securely connecting applications, data, APIs and AI agents across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapLogic-Company-Overview-2026.pdf

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes Essential, Professional and Enterprise One packages. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The pricing page displays Aramark and Adobe customer logos linked to the customer section. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/pricing | named_customers.0: Aramark appears in the pricing page's customer-logo area. | named_customers.1: Adobe appears in the pricing page's customer-logo area.

employee_band.notes: ZoomInfo explicitly lists 201–500 employees. This is a third-party estimate rather than a company-confirmed headcount. Source: https://www.zoominfo.com/c/snaplogic-inc/262291773

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company overview explicitly identifies San Mateo, California as headquarters. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapLogic-Company-Overview-2026.pdf | hq_country: The company overview places headquarters in San Mateo, California; the company profile explicitly supplies United States. Sources: https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapLogic-Company-Overview-2026.pdf and https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/snaplogic

founded_year.notes: The company overview explicitly says SnapLogic was founded in 2006. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapLogic-Company-Overview-2026.pdf

eng_blog.notes: SnapLogic Engineering has engineer-authored posts explaining reliable Kafka batching and the architecture of SnapLogic's internal data platform. The latter concerns internal infrastructure rather than the customer-facing product itself, so the classification has some interpretive uncertainty. Sources: https://medium.com/snaplogic-engineering/reliable-high-throughput-batching-with-the-kafka-consumer-snap-7c65e41e204b and https://medium.com/snaplogic-engineering/how-to-build-a-better-data-platform-using-snaplogic-88285e01c02

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple product and developer sections, including Admin Manager, Public APIs and AutoSync. Source: https://docs.snaplogic.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Applied AI Architect posting seeks a fractional contractor and provides an application link. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/snaplogic/3d408fe5-5fbb-4402-9c36-54a2bf2b9b59

model_provider.notes: SnapLogic publicly identifies Anthropic's Claude, made available in SnapGPT through Amazon Bedrock. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/amazon-bedrock-anthropic-claude-available-in-snapgpt

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: SnapLogic claims SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA-HITECH certification and GDPR compliance. ISO 27001 is described as an AWS capability, not SnapLogic's own certification, so it is excluded. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/products/security-compliance | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 certification. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly claims HIPAA-HITECH certification. | compliance_certs.2: The security page explicitly claims GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest dated capital-raising transaction is classified as Debt - General. A newer undated secondary transaction is not treated as company fundraising. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/51376-87 | funding_date: PitchBook lists completed debt financing dated August 13, 2025, yielding 2025-08. Other funding databases stop at older equity rounds; this later entry was not corroborated by a financing announcement. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/51376-87 | funding_amount_usd: The newest dated financing entry is completed debt financing on August 13, 2025, but its amount is blank. The $165 million disclosed for December 2021 cannot be assigned to this later transaction. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/51376-87

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook records completed debt financing on August 13, 2025, inside the 18-month window. This supports true, but no dated financing announcement or filing corroborating that entry was found, so the evidence falls short of the requested primary-source standard. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/51376-87

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Sales Development Representative EMEA posting lists a full-time sales-development role and an application link. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/snaplogic/1728258e-f2e2-4913-93b0-e77077ab3f8b

launched_6mo.notes: The October 20, 2026 announcement introduces platform capabilities for building AI agents and connecting them to business systems and data, inside the six-month window. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/snaplogic-expands-agentic-integration-platform-ai-agents

leadership_change_12mo.notes: SnapLogic announced Molly Matthews's appointment as President on May 12, 2026, inside the 12-month window. This treats the company-wide President position as C-suite-level executive leadership. The same announcement's internal chief-officer promotions are not counted as external joins. Source: https://www.snaplogic.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/snaplogic-appoints-molly-matthews-president-leadership-expansion

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The SDR posting explicitly requires updating Salesforce and names Salesforce, Zoominfo, SalesLoft and LeadIQ among relevant computer skills. Actual use is explicit for Salesforce and suggested by the requirements for the other systems. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/snaplogic/1728258e-f2e2-4913-93b0-e77077ab3f8b | crm_stack_signal.0: The SDR responsibilities explicitly require recording prospect interactions in Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The SDR skills requirement names Zoominfo, indicating a sales-stack signal rather than independently verified deployment. | crm_stack_signal.2: The SDR skills requirement names SalesLoft, indicating a sales-stack signal. | crm_stack_signal.3: The SDR skills requirement names LeadIQ, indicating a sales-stack signal.
